title: AFTER HTTP-service comparison rules, version 1
description: The single fixed HTTP-service policy accepted by the current comparator. This is not a user-extensible rule language.

const.responses: ordered HTTP status and body; JSON bodies structural, otherwise exact text
const.provider_calls: ordered observer-received timestamp, endpoint, method, path, idempotency key and body
const.json: exact decimal values, object key order ignored, arrays ordered, null distinct from missing; reject duplicate keys and invalid Unicode
